declarations.normative_text: Use model-data-delta-seed names, H:/Expect:/Outcome notes, family/arch/train/data/provenance, namespaced metrics/summaries, rank-zero logging and stable ids. Slugs/note length are advice.

Never judge success/convergence. Record caller verdicts from hanig-verified-workflow contracts and hanig-swarm/converge.py predicates. Expect quotes the predeclared predicate. Mark post-result checkpoints post hoc in card caveats.
Use authorized access and caller-supplied W&B; scripts use stdlib. Missing access leaves logging evidence incomplete.
Set HANIG_WANDB_LOGGING_DIR to the loaded SKILL.md directory; data/output stay project-relative.

Record only program basename, flags and positional count for commands, with no digest; omit values except option-shaped tokens before --, recorded by the flag rule. Mask secret-keyed config values recursively and their verbatim values of at least 6 characters in sent strings. Never put credentials in notes or names; use the environment, never config. Free text is not otherwise scanned.
Show a logging plan; confirm shared naming/edits. Never delete runs/artifact versions as cleanup.
